subject.title: Manage Claw cron jobs through the gateway

question: Should the restacked Claws design include cron ownership reconciliation in this slice, require it as an atomic companion, or defer scheduler mutation?
rationale: The active RFC rejects the current prototype as the final contract, and repository evidence does not establish which layer should permanently own recovery from scheduler/ledger divergence.

options.title: Restack with reconciliation
options.body: Define and implement deterministic declaration adoption and idempotent cleanup before making the cron slice ready.

options.title: Require an atomic companion
options.body: Permit a split only if a concrete reconciliation PR is reviewed and lands together with this ownership slice.

options.title: Defer scheduler mutation
options.body: Keep cron declarations portable but postpone gateway mutation until the lifecycle contract is accepted.

recommendation.title: Restack with reconciliation
recommendation.body: Define and implement deterministic declaration adoption and idempotent cleanup before making the cron slice ready.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent ownership of the gateway cron convergence contract makes them the strongest available decision route for scheduler-side semantics.
